document_status: BOUNDED TECHNICAL CENSUS COMPLETE / PROVISIONAL / NOT CANON FREEZE
purpose: Demonstrate source-explicit coverage of every load-bearing term needed to begin Gate0 migration work, while preserving competing definitions and version identities.
authority_effect: This census classifies and locates terms; it does not select canon.
REGISTERED means already present in the Phase0 starter registry, not peer-review acceptance or empirical validation.
PROPOSED_ADD is a registry change proposal only.
TYPED_VARIANT preserves a source/profile identity and blocks silent interchange.
EXPLICITLY_OUT_OF_SCOPE is a bounded Gate0 disposition, not a claim that the term is unimportant.

scope.unit_of_census: A term, symbol, closed-vocabulary member, schema field, or source-profile identity.
include_if_any: Changing the item changes parsing, typing, serialization, or an exported API field.
Changing the item changes an ontology member, crosswalk, theorem hypothesis, axiom, proof-status boundary, or algebra profile.
Changing the item changes a path/dynamic interpretation, measurement computation, calibration, evidence eligibility, or reproducibility binding.
Changing the item can silently collapse two versioned source identities.
exclude_only_when: The item is ordinary prose, a theorem-local binder, an equation/chapter number, or non-serialized UI copy and crosses none of the inclusion predicates.
The item belongs to a named advanced track deferred to Gate1 and is explicitly represented by an EXPLICITLY_OUT_OF_SCOPE group.
Native TKS metaphysical/cultural/teleological content is preserved in its source but excluded from CAS migration by the registered translation boundary.
scope.atomicity_rule: A closed enumeration is represented by a group plus every member. Group source locations apply to all members; a source_location_template plus each member's index resolves an exact JSON Pointer.
scope.completeness_claim: Complete only relative to the listed source snapshot and inclusion predicate; not a word census and not a Gate1 theorem-declaration inventory.

classification_vocabulary.REGISTERED: Already admitted by exact ID in the Phase0 symbol and terminology registry; metadata is inherited verbatim where imported.
classification_vocabulary.PROPOSED_ADD: Load-bearing source term absent from the starter registry and proposed for an owner-reviewed registry addition.
classification_vocabulary.TYPED_VARIANT: A competing, implementation-specific, experimental, or source-version identity that must remain typed and may not silently replace another.
classification_vocabulary.EXPLICITLY_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Reviewed surface intentionally deferred or excluded under the bounded Gate0 scope.

location_inheritance.group_source_locations: Every member inherits its group's source_locations.
location_inheritance.source_location_templates: Replace each {field_name} with the same member's integer/string field to obtain an exact locator.
location_inheritance.member_override: A future member-specific source_locations field adds to, rather than erases, inherited locations.

imported_registry.metadata_resolution: Import all listed entries verbatim, including semantic_type, version_scope, source_refs, aliases_allowed, forbidden_aliases, and migration_policy. The verifier rejects any missing or extra starter entry.
